title: CombatState
description: The root of combat-state.json: the battle as the player's HUD shows it, written when every phase begins and after every unit's activation; the file exists only while a battle is running.

modVersion.description: The four-part version of the mod that wrote the file; the other files match the catalog written by the same version.

exportedAt.description: When the file was last written, in ISO 8601 with the local time's UTC offset.

trigger.description: What caused the export that last wrote the file.

contract.description: The contract being fought, as in mission-outcome.json contract.

mapId.description: The map's id in the game's metadata database, which keys catalog.json mapDefinitions; a map no star system's contracts are generated on, e.g. a story map, has no entry there. null where the map isn't in the metadata database.

phase.description: The current phase as the HUD numbers it, as CombatUnitState.initiative: units act from 5 down to 1.

resolve.description: The lance's resolve now; its limits are in rules.json combat.resolve.

movementLegend.description: How to read the units' CombatUnit.movement.

units.description: Every unit the player knows of, keyed by the game's unit id: the player's and allied units, and the enemies and neutral units the HUD shows or last showed.

objectives.description: The objectives the HUD lists, finished ones included, in the HUD's order.

zones.description: The zones drawn on the map.

landingZones.description: Where a dropship or drop pods are about to land, which the HUD marks as dangerous: a unit standing there is crushed when they do. Entries come and go as the mission readies landings and they happen.

buildingSides.description: The buildings on a side, e.g. a base to destroy or defend, by their id in combat-map.json buildings and in the order of their ids; the others are on none. The mission's script can change a building's side during the battle.

damagedBuildings.description: The buildings of combat-map.json buildings below their max structure, destroyed ones included, in the order of their ids; the others are undamaged.

MissionContract.description: The contract a mission was for.

id.description: The contract's id from the game's data files; null where the game keeps no reference to it.

name.description: The contract's name, as the contract list shows it.

type.description: The mission type, described in rules.json contractTypes.

displayStyle.description: Whether it's a regular, story, restoration or flashpoint contract.

employer.description: The faction that hires the company.

target.description: The faction the mission is fought against; INVALID_UNSET, which has no catalog.json factionDefinitions entry, for a story contract that only travels.

difficulty.description: The difficulty on the skulls' scale of 1 to 10 (two per skull), capped at rules.json campaign.contracts.maxGlobalDifficulty; the value rules.json reputationLevels[].maxContractDifficulty limits.

starSystem.description: The star system the mission is fought in.

DefinitionReference.description: A game definition: its id from the game's data files and the name shown in the UI.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction), for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

ContractDisplayStyle.description: Whether a contract is a regular, story, restoration or flashpoint contract.

MovementLegend.description: How to read UnitMovement's rows, spelled out so the file explains itself.

moves.description: How to read the characters of the moves.

fire.description: The first character of an attack: how the unit could fire at the target from the hex.

side.description: The second character of an attack: the side of the target an attack from the hex hits.

CombatUnit.description: A unit in combat, with as much of it as the HUD shows at its visibility.

side.description: Whose side the unit is on.

visibility.description: How much of the unit the HUD shows, deciding which of its other fields are set.

kind.description: The kind of unit; null where the HUD doesn't tell: at blipMinimum and lastSeen.

tonnage.description: The unit's tonnage, in tons; null where the HUD doesn't tell: for a blip below blipMaximum, a turret blip, which shows its weight class instead, and when last seen.

weightClass.description: The unit's weight class; null where the HUD doesn't tell: for a blip below blipMaximum, a mech or vehicle blip, which shows its tonnage instead, and when last seen.

definition.description: The mech, vehicle or turret in the catalog, which holds its armor and loadout; null for the player's mechs, which have bayMech instead, and for units out of full view.

bayMech.description: The player's mech in game-state.json, whose loadout holds its assigned armor; null for every other unit.

position.description: Where the unit is, or was last detected at for lastSeen.

facingDegrees.description: The direction the unit faces, in degrees clockwise seen from above, to 0.1°: 0 towards the map's +z, 90 towards its +x, up to below 360. A blip's marker shows it at every level; null when last seen.

terrain.description: The terrain the unit stands in, keyed as in catalog.json terrainDefinitions, which a blip's position on the map shows; null on open ground and when last seen.

pilot.description: The pilot, which the HUD names only at full; null below it and for a unit without a pilot.

state.description: The unit's condition, which the HUD shows only at full; null below it.

linesOfFire.description: The lines of fire to the units it could attack: from the player's units to every living enemy at full, and from those enemies to the player's units. null for the others, destroyed units included.

movement.description: Where the player's unit can move and what it gets there; null for the others, and for a unit that can't move (a turret, a prone or shut down mech).

TeamSide.description: A team's side, seen from the player: a unit's or a building's.

allegiance.description: Whose side the team is on, seen from the player.

UnitAllegiance.description: Whose side a team in combat is on, seen from the player: its units' and its buildings'.

UnitVisibility.description: How much of a unit the player's HUD shows (the game's VisibilityLevel).

UnitKind.description: The kind of a unit in combat, which tells the catalog group of its definition.

MechReference.description: A mech in the mech bay, by its own id and name there (game-state.json mechs).

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction), for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

MapPosition.description: A point on the map in meters: y is the elevation.

x.description: Along the map's x axis, 0 at the map's center, to 0.1 m.

y.description: The elevation, on the scale of combat-map.json rows[].elevations.

z.description: Along the map's z axis, 0 at the map's center, to 0.1 m.

PilotReference.description: A pilot: their id, full name without callsign, and callsign.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction), for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

callsign.description: The pilot's callsign, which isn't part of name.

CombatUnitState.description: A unit's condition as the HUD shows it, for a unit in full view.

deathMethod.description: How the unit was destroyed, as the game records it (DeathMethod), e.g. CenterTorsoDestruction, LegDestruction, PilotKilled (also an incapacitated pilot), PilotEjection, a turret's CenterTorsoDestruction or a vehicle's VehicleLocationDestroyed; null while the unit lives.

locations.description: The armor and structure left per location, in the game's order: a mech's from head to legs, a vehicle's from front to rear and turret, a turret's single one. The limits are in CombatUnit.definition or CombatUnit.bayMech.

evasionPips.description: The evasive pips the unit has, earned by moving (see rules.json combat.evasion).

guard.description: The unit's guard level and its sources.

isEntrenched.description: Whether the unit is entrenched, e.g. by bracing, until its next activation: weapons' stability damage against it is multiplied by rules.json combat.stability.entrenchedInstabilityMultiplier.

isProne.description: Whether the mech has been knocked down; only mechs can be.

isShutDown.description: Whether the unit is shut down, e.g. from overheating.

isUnsteady.description: Whether the mech is unsteady: its instability rose above MechStability.unsteadyAbove and hasn't fallen below since; only mechs can be.

mech.description: What only a mech has; null for vehicles and turrets.

hasActivated.description: Whether the unit has finished its activation this round.

initiative.description: The phase the unit acts in, on the scale of phase.

components.description: Every component mounted, in the game's order.

pilot.description: The pilot's condition; null without a pilot.

abilities.description: The pilot's and components' abilities that can be activated, with their cooldowns.

resolveCosts.description: What Precision Strike and Vigilance cost the unit now, which its pilot's spirits change; null for the units not in the player's lance, which spend no resolve.

DeathMethod.description: How a unit was destroyed, as the game records it.

UnitLocation.description: A location's armor and structure left, in whole points as the paper doll shows them.

location.description: The game's name of the location: a mech's as in catalog.json chassisDefinitions.*.locations[].location, a vehicle's as in catalog.json vehicleDefinitions.*.locations[].location, or Structure for a turret's single location.

armor.description: The armor left, by side; only a mech's torso has a rear.

structure.description: The structure left; 0 once the location is destroyed.

LocationArmorOfInteger.description: A location's armor by side, in whatever a file measures armor in.

front.description: The front armor; outside the torso, the location's only armor.

rear.description: null outside the torso, which alone has rear armor.

Guard.description: The unit's guard, which the HUD shows as guarded at level 1 or more.

level.description: What the sources below add up to: bracing and cover 1 each, Bulwark 1 more on top of either, unless the unit was hit in melee since its last activation. Bracing and Bulwark don't count while the guard is broken (unsteady, prone, shut down, sensor locked or hit), and none while the unit moves.

isBraced.description: Braced in its last activation, until its next one.

hasCover.description: Standing in a terrain that grants guard.

MechState.description: What only a mech's condition has: its heat and stability bars.

MechHeat.description: A mech's heat as the HUD's heat bar shows it, with the thresholds it draws and the sinking it predicts.

dissipation.description: The heat the mech sheds at the end of its activation now: its heat sinks after the terrain it stands in, the biome and effects; standing in water or on a cold map changes it.

overheatsAbove.description: The heat above which the mech overheats, after the pilot's Guts and effects; the base is in rules.json combat.heat.overheatsAbove.

maxHeat.description: The heat at which the mech shuts down, after heat banks and effects; the base is in rules.json combat.heat.maxHeat.

MechStability.description: A mech's stability as the HUD's stability bar shows it, with the thresholds it draws.

current.description: The instability taken, from 0 up, as the bar fills.

unsteadyAbove.description: The instability above which the mech is unsteady and loses its evasive pips, after effects; the base is rules.json combat.stability.unsteadyAbovePercent of maxStability.

maxStability.description: The instability at which the mech is knocked down: the chassis' stability, as its MaxStability statistic has it now.

CombatComponent.description: A component mounted on a unit, with its condition in the battle.

component.description: The component, by the id its definition is keyed by.

location.description: The game's name of the location it is mounted in, as UnitLocation.location.

damageLevel.description: The game's damage level, e.g. Functional or Destroyed.

shotsLeft.description: The shots left in an ammunition box, or in a weapon that carries its own; null for other components. A destroyed box has none.

ComponentReference.description: A component's definition, like DefinitionReference, with the type that tells which group of catalog.json componentDefinitions holds it. Components compare by type first, then as every reference.

id.description: The id it's referred to by: for a definition its id from the game's data files, or its name in the game's enumeration where it has no data file (e.g. the player's faction), for a mech in the mech bay or a pilot the game's own id of it.

type.description: The game's component type, e.g. Weapon or AmmunitionBox, which names the component's group in catalog.json componentDefinitions; never NotSet, Special or MechPart, which the game's enum also has.

ComponentType.description: The game's kind of component, which names the component's group in catalog.json componentDefinitions.

CombatPilotState.description: A unit's pilot's condition in the battle.

injuries.description: The injuries, including those from before the mission.

health.description: The injuries at which the pilot is incapacitated, as in mission-outcome.json lance[].health.

bonusHealth.description: The bonus health left, which takes hits before they become injuries and is used up by them; the portrait shows it on top of health.

skills.description: The skill levels the game computes with now, temporary changes from effects included; exported for every pilot in full view, though the HUD shows only the player's.

Skills.description: A pilot's skill levels, each from 1 to 10.

gunnery.description: The Gunnery level, whose training table is rules.json skills.gunnery.

piloting.description: The Piloting level, whose training table is rules.json skills.piloting.

guts.description: The Guts level, whose training table is rules.json skills.guts.

tactics.description: The Tactics level, whose training table is rules.json skills.tactics.

CombatAbility.description: An ability a unit can activate, as its HUD button shows it.

ability.description: The ability, the pilot's or a mounted component's.

cooldown.description: The unit's activations until the ability can be used again; 0 when ready.

usesLeft.description: The uses left of an ability that can be used only so often; null without a limit.

ResolveCosts.description: The resolve a mech's Precision Strike and Vigilance cost.

precisionStrikeCost.description: The resolve a Precision Strike costs.

LineOfFire.description: How a unit could fire at a target from where it stands, as hovering over the target shows it.

target.description: The target's unit id, a key of units.

blocking.description: How much of the line of fire itself is blocked. A target beyond every weapon's range and the unit's sensors is blocked too.

fire.description: Whether the unit's weapons could fire at the target directly, only indirectly or not at all, or it is out of their range.

isInFiringArc.description: Whether the target is in the unit's firing arc without turning.

LineOfFireBlocking.description: How much of a line of fire is blocked (the game's LineOfFireLevel).

FireAvailability.description: How a unit could fire at a target from where it stands (the game's FiringPreviewManager).

UnitMovement.description: The hexes a player's unit can end its move on, read from the game's own pathing, with the evasion it gets and the attacks it has there. A unit that has activated gets those of its next activation, from where it stands. Laid out in rows of characters, as MovementLegend explains, like combat-map.json rows, whose hexes give each hex's terrain and elevation.

targets.description: The enemies at full by unit id, in the order of MovementRow.attacks.

rows.description: The rows with a hex the unit can reach, by r.

MovementRow.description: Consecutive hexes of one row, from (q, r) to the last one the unit can reach, one character per hex in each move and two per hex in each attack.

q.description: The axial q of the row's first hex, the first character of each move and attack.

r.description: The axial r of every hex in the row.

walk.description: The evasion pips per hex as MovementLegend.moves says.

sprint.description: The evasion pips per hex when sprinting, as MovementLegend.moves says; null for a legged or unsteady mech, which can't sprint.

reverse.description: The evasion pips per hex when moving backward, as MovementLegend.moves says.

jump.description: The evasion pips per hex when jumping, as MovementLegend.moves says; null for a vehicle and a mech without a working jump jet.

attacks.description: Per entry of UnitMovement.targets, the fire and side as MovementLegend.fire and MovementLegend.side say.

CombatObjective.description: An objective in the HUD's objective list.

id.description: The game's id of the objective, which ObjectiveZone.objectiveIds refer to.

title.description: The title the HUD shows, as plain text.

status.description: The objective's game status, e.g. Active, Succeeded or Failed.

isPrimary.description: Whether the HUD lists it as a primary objective.

progress.description: The progress line the HUD shows under the title, e.g. a count of units destroyed; null where it shows none.

targetUnitIds.description: The units it is about (to destroy, protect or escort), as keys of units, while they are in full view: neither blips nor destroyed enemies.

targetBuildingIds.description: The buildings it is about (to destroy or defend), by their combat-map.json buildings[].id.

beacon.description: Where the HUD draws the objective's beacon, 2 m above the ground, e.g. where the reinforcements it announces will land; null where it draws none: an objective that marks its target units instead, or a finished one.

ObjectiveZone.description: A zone drawn on the map, e.g. a capture or evacuation zone.

id.description: The game's id of the zone.

type.description: The game's id of the zone's region definition, e.g. regionDef_EvacZone, which names what the zone is for.

center.description: The zone's center on the map.

radius.description: The radius of the hexagon the HUD draws, in meters; whether a unit is inside is decided per map cell, which this only approximates.

isPreview.description: Drawn as a zone that becomes active later.

objectiveIds.description: The objectives the zone belongs to among objectives, as CombatObjective.id; empty where it belongs only to objectives the HUD doesn't list.

LandingZone.description: A landing zone the HUD marks as dangerous.

id.description: The game's id of the dropship, or of the lance spawner whose drop pods land there.

hexes.description: The hexes whose center cell the game marks, in the order of combat-map.json rows; a unit standing on one is crushed. A dropship's whole footprint, or the hex each drop pod lands on, one per unit of the lance.

LandingZoneKind.description: What is about to land on a landing zone.

HexCoordinates.description: A hex of combat-map.json rows by its axial coordinates.

q.description: The hex's axial q, as in combat-map.json hexGrid.

r.description: The hex's axial r, as in combat-map.json hexGrid.

BuildingSide.description: A building on a side, highlighted in its team's color on the map.

id.description: The building's id in combat-map.json buildings.

side.description: Whose side the building is on, as a unit has it.

DamagedBuilding.description: A building below its max structure, or destroyed.

id.description: The building's id in combat-map.json buildings.

structure.description: The structure left; its max is in combat-map.json buildings[].maxStructure.

destroyedHexes.description: The hexes the building stood on, with the ground's elevation and the rubble's terrain they now have in place of those in combat-map.json, which isn't rewritten when it falls; units on its roof drop to the ground. null while it stands.

MapHex.description: A hex of combat-map.json rows as it is now.

q.description: The hex's axial q, as in combat-map.json hexGrid.

r.description: The hex's axial r, as in combat-map.json hexGrid.

terrain.description: Keyed as in catalog.json terrainDefinitions; null on open ground.
